about: The chalkboard on the Lab Director's Desk. The weekly refresh replaces weekOf and puts new items first. Keep 3 to 6 items; each source must be an official page or a page inside this workshop.

items.title: The workshop doors are open
items.body: Thirteen benches on three arcs, a Lab Director at four of them, challenges at three levels and a self-check at every bench.

items.title: New lesson: Connectors
items.body: How connectors plug Claude into the apps you already use, and what Claude can see once they're connected.

items.title: New recipe: Make a skill just by chatting
items.body: Describe how you do a job and let Claude ask the questions. It writes the skill for you.

items.title: Try the Inspection Bench
items.body: The habit that separates great Claude users from good ones: checking. Start with Spot the fib.
